answer: Every submission must name 2 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The trellis graph is validated at intake and the bridge frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and dawn anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Scaling up is where the attack dies: 216 fake identities need 1041 separate proofs, each held 60 days, so the bill grows in a straight line while the reward stays flat. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
